title: Ruler tape configuration
statement: Let $K$ be a natural number, let $y$ and $z$ be finite Boolean strings, let $d$ be a configuration of a $K$-tape machine on input $z$, let $r$ be one of its work-tape indices, let $i$ be an input-head position among the $|y|+2$ positions, and let $$ be a natural number. The ruler condition holds if $0<\le |z|$, the string obtained from $z$ by deleting its first $$ symbols is $y$, and the input head is at position $+i$. In addition, for every integer $p$ with $-1\le p\le $, the selected work tape at offset $p$ from its head agrees with the tape encoding a string of $$ true symbols.
